table.retrieve:
select B.purtype,
         date=B.days,
         amount= B.grossamount + B.tax
	     
       

 FROM 

      (

       SELECT
				purtype=ISNULL(A.purchasetype,'OTHERS'),
				purtypecode=A.purtypecode,
				grossamount=sum(A.invamount),
				tax=SUM(A.totaltax),
				days= convert(varchar(12), max(A.date),3)
		
		FROM



				(  SELECT invcode = dbo.purledger.purinvcode,    
         				 date = dbo.purledger.date,    
         				flatdisc = dbo.purledger.flatdisc , 
	 						salestax= dbo.purledger.salestax ,       
         				misccharges = dbo.purledger.misccharges , 
	 						invdiscperc = dbo.purledger.discperc , 
	 						invgstperc1 = dbo.purledger.invgstperc1 , 
	 						invtype = Case dbo.purledger.purcatcode 	When 1 Then 'Cash' 	When 2 Then 'Credit' When 7 Then 'Loose' When 8 Then 'Loose' Else 'Opening' End,  
         				dbo.accounts.name, 
         				amount =  Sum ((dbo.purdetail.looseqty + dbo.purdetail.packqty ) * dbo.purdetail.purprice),    
							itemdiscpercvalue = Sum ( (dbo.purdetail.looseqty + dbo.purdetail.packqty ) * dbo.purdetail.purprice * (dbo.purdetail.discperc / 100)),    
    						invdiscpercvalue = Sum ( (dbo.purdetail.looseqty + dbo.purdetail.packqty ) * dbo.purdetail.purprice * (1 - dbo.purdetail.discperc / 100)) * (dbo.purledger.discperc / 100)    ,
							itemsalestax = Sum (Round ( (dbo.purdetail.looseqty + dbo.purdetail.packqty + dbo.purdetail.bonusqty) * dbo.purdetail.unitsalestax + Round ( Round ( (dbo.purdetail.looseqty + dbo.purdetail.packqty ) * dbo.purdetail.purprice * (1 - dbo.purdetail.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * dbo.purdetail.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) ) ,
							posted= dbo.purledger.posted,
							Purchasetype=dbo.purchasetype.name,
							purtypecode=dbo.purchasetype.purtypecode,
							postdate=purledger.postdate,
							dbo.purledger.GRN,

							invamount=ISNULL(  Round(Sum ((dbo.purdetail.looseqty + dbo.purdetail.packqty ) * dbo.purdetail.purprice)
											- Sum ( (dbo.purdetail.looseqty + dbo.purdetail.packqty ) * dbo.purdetail.purprice * (dbo.purdetail.discperc / 100))
											- Sum ( (dbo.purdetail.looseqty + dbo.purdetail.packqty ) * dbo.purdetail.purprice * (1 - dbo.purdetail.discperc / 100)) * (dbo.purledger.discperc / 100)
											- purledger.flatdisc + purledger.misccharges, 0),0),


							totaltax=ISNULL(	Round(Round(Round( Sum ((dbo.purdetail.looseqty + dbo.purdetail.packqty ) * dbo.purdetail.purprice)
		 								- Sum ( (dbo.purdetail.looseqty + dbo.purdetail.packqty ) * dbo.purdetail.purprice * (dbo.purdetail.discperc / 100))
										 -  Sum ( (dbo.purdetail.looseqty + dbo.purdetail.packqty ) * dbo.purdetail.purprice * (1 - dbo.purdetail.discperc / 100)) * (dbo.purledger.discperc / 100)   
		 								- purledger.flatdisc,2) * 0.01 * purledger.invgstperc1,2)

										+
		
										 Sum (Round ( (dbo.purdetail.looseqty + dbo.purdetail.packqty + dbo.purdetail.bonusqty) * dbo.purdetail.unitsalestax + Round ( Round ( (dbo.purdetail.looseqty + dbo.purdetail.packqty ) * dbo.purdetail.purprice * (1 - dbo.purdetail.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * dbo.purdetail.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) ),0)
											,0)

				
    		FROM 
			dbo.purledger
			LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.PurchaseType ON (dbo.purledger.purtypecode = dbo.purchasetype.purtypecode),
			dbo.purdetail,   
			dbo.accounts

		WHERE ( dbo.purledger.purinvcode = dbo.purdetail.purinvcode ) and  
			( dbo.purledger.suppcode = dbo.accounts.acccode )and  
			( dbo.purledger.date>=:ar_startdate and purledger.date<=:ar_enddate)            

			GROUP BY dbo.accounts.name,   
         			dbo.purledger.misccharges,   
         			dbo.purledger.flatdisc,   
         			dbo.purledger.date,
	 					dbo.purledger.postdate,   
         			dbo.purledger.purinvcode, 
	 					dbo.purchasetype.name,  
	 					dbo.purchasetype.purtypecode,
	 					dbo.purledger.discperc,  
	 					dbo.purledger.invgstperc1,
	 					dbo.purledger.salestax,
	 					dbo.purledger.purcatcode,
         			dbo.purledger.posted,
	 					dbo.purledger.GRN

				) as A


	group by  datepart(dy,A.date),
	  			 A.purchasetype,
	  			 A.purtypecode

) AS B


UNION ALL

select purchasetype.name,
		 null,
			0
from purchasetype
where purtypecode not in ( select distinct(purtypecode) from purledger
									where purledger.date>=:ar_startdate and purledger.date<=:ar_enddate)
/*---------When there is no 'OTHERS' Type --------*/

UNION 

select 'OTHERS',
			null,
			0
/*------end----------------------*/

/*---------When there is no '[RETURN]'  --------*/

UNION 

select '[RETURN]',
			null,
			0
/*------end----------------------*/

UNION ALL

SELECT  '[RETURN]',
	days=PR.day,
	sum(PR.netamount)* (- 1)
	
from (  SELECT invcode = dbo.prledger.prinvcode,    
        			 day = Convert(varchar(12),max(prledger.date),3),    
        			 flatdisc = dbo.prledger.flatdisc, 
	 				 salestax= dbo.prledger.salestax,       
        			 misccharges = dbo.prledger.misccharges, 
					 invdiscperc = dbo.prledger.discperc,  
 					 invgstperc1 = dbo.prledger.invgstperc1,  
					 invtype = Case dbo.prledger.prcatcode 	When 4 Then 'Cash' 	When 5 Then 'Credit' End,   
       			  dbo.accounts.name, 
       			  amount =  Sum ( (dbo.prdetail.looseqty + dbo.prdetail.packqty) * dbo.prdetail.prprice),    
					 itemdiscpercvalue = Sum ( (dbo.prdetail.looseqty + dbo.prdetail.packqty ) * dbo.prdetail.prprice * (dbo.prdetail.discperc /100)),    
    				 invdiscpercvalue = Sum ( (dbo.prdetail.looseqty + dbo.prdetail.packqty )  * dbo.prdetail.prprice * (1 - dbo.prdetail.discperc /100)) * (dbo.prledger.discperc /100) , 
					 totalsalestax =   Round (
		  								 /*invoice level salestax*/Round ( ( Round ( Sum ( Round ( (dbo.prdetail.looseqty + dbo.prdetail.packqty ) * dbo.prdetail.prprice * (1 - dbo.prdetail.discperc * 0.01 ) , 2 ) )
								  	       * ( 1 - dbo.prledger.discperc * 0.01 ) , 2 ) - dbo.prledger.flatdisc ) * dbo.prledger.invgstperc1 * 0.01  , 2 )
 		  								 /*items salestax*/	 + Sum (Round ( (dbo.prdetail.looseqty + dbo.prdetail.packqty + dbo.prdetail.bonusqty) * dbo.prdetail.unitsalestax + Round ( Round ( (dbo.prdetail.looseqty + dbo.prdetail.packqty) * dbo.prdetail.prprice * (1 - dbo.prdetail.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * dbo.prdetail.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) )
											 , 0 ),
					netamount=Round( Sum ( (dbo.prdetail.looseqty + dbo.prdetail.packqty) * dbo.prdetail.prprice)
		  						- Sum ( (dbo.prdetail.looseqty + dbo.prdetail.packqty ) * dbo.prdetail.prprice * (dbo.prdetail.discperc /100))
		 						 - Sum ( (dbo.prdetail.looseqty + dbo.prdetail.packqty )  * dbo.prdetail.prprice * (1 - dbo.prdetail.discperc /100)) * (dbo.prledger.discperc /100)
								  - flatdisc + misccharges
		 						 +
								Round (
		   					/*invoice level salestax*/Round ( ( Round ( Sum ( Round ( (dbo.prdetail.looseqty + dbo.prdetail.packqty ) * dbo.prdetail.prprice * (1 - dbo.prdetail.discperc * 0.01 ) , 2 ) )
							  	 * ( 1 - dbo.prledger.discperc * 0.01 ) , 2 ) - dbo.prledger.flatdisc ) * dbo.prledger.invgstperc1 * 0.01  , 2 )
 		  						 /*items salestax*/	 + Sum (Round ( (dbo.prdetail.looseqty + dbo.prdetail.packqty + dbo.prdetail.bonusqty) * dbo.prdetail.unitsalestax + Round ( Round ( (dbo.prdetail.looseqty + dbo.prdetail.packqty) * dbo.prdetail.prprice * (1 - dbo.prdetail.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * dbo.prdetail.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) )
											 , 0 ),0)

   	 FROM dbo.prledger,    
	 			dbo.prdetail,    
         	dbo.accounts   	
   	WHERE ( dbo.prledger.prinvcode = dbo.prdetail.prinvcode ) and  
        		 ( dbo.prledger.suppcode = dbo.accounts.acccode )and  
     			 ( dbo.prledger.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate)            

		GROUP BY dbo.accounts.name,   
        			 dbo.prledger.misccharges,   
        			 dbo.prledger.flatdisc,   
         		dbo.prledger.date,   
         		dbo.prledger.prinvcode,   
	 				dbo.prledger.discperc,  
	 				dbo.prledger.invgstperc1 ,
	 				dbo.prledger.salestax, 
	 				dbo.prledger.prcatcode    

) PR

Group by pr.day

order by B.days
